details: The U.S. SEC is set to propose a new rule, "Regulation Crypto," this month to ease securities compliance for crypto startups and fundraising. It would create temporary registration exemptions for developers and establish a safe harbor for issuers.
title: SEC to Propose "Regulation Crypto" for Startups

details: Santiment data reveals that Bitcoin's exchange supply is at its lowest since 2017, and Ethereum's since 2015. This indicates a significant shift of assets into self-custody or staking, suggesting increased investor confidence and reduced immediate selling pressure.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum Exchange Supply Nears All-Time Lows

details: Bitcoin (BTC) dipped below $62,000 after US President Donald Trump declared the US-Iran ceasefire "over," leading to renewed airstrikes and escalating geopolitical tensions. This triggered a broader market sell-off and raised concerns about global economic stability.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Cause Bitcoin Dip Below $62,000

details: EDX Markets, an institutional crypto exchange, secured $76 million in a Series C funding round led by Japan's SBI Holdings. This investment will support EDX's expansion of trading, clearing, and settlement services, as well as product development and global scaling.
title: SBI Holdings Leads $76M Funding Round for EDX Markets

details: Vanguard, a major asset management firm, is hiring its first Head of Digital Assets to guide its strategy in crypto and blockchain. This signals a notable shift for the previously crypto-skeptical firm, now evaluating tokenization, stablecoins, custody, and blockchain settlement.
title: Vanguard Seeks First Head of Digital Assets

details: Russia's State Duma committee approved the final draft of its crypto regulation bill, removing the mandatory requirement for users to declare crypto wallet addresses. Instead, only balances and transaction flows need to be reported.
title: Russia Drops Wallet Reporting from Final Crypto Bill

details: US Bitcoin spot ETFs experienced nearly $500 million in inflows over two trading sessions. However, on-chain data suggests that underlying demand for Bitcoin remains weak, raising questions about the sustainability of the recent rebound.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $500M Inflows, But Underlying Demand Weak

details: Strategy (formerly MicroStrategy) sold 3,588 Bitcoin for approximately $216 million between June 29 and July 5 to fund dividend payments on its preferred securities. This marks their largest BTC disposal and signals a shift from their long-standing "never sell" policy.
title: Strategy (MicroStrategy) Sells 3,588 BTC for $216M

details: BonkDAO, the decentralized autonomous organization for the BONK memecoin, lost an estimated $20 million in BONK tokens. An attacker exploited a vulnerability in the token-weighted governance system by acquiring enough voting power to pass a malicious proposal that redirected treasury funds.
title: BonkDAO Suffers $20M Loss in Governance Attack
